notes: Deviation from Split Studio's default: row-level direction alternation was dropped. At these row heights the zigzag broke the numbered index column and read as a layout bug rather than a rhythm. The diptych plus hairlines carry the macrostructure on their own.
amendments: Light drop: anchor moved 258 to 248 (azure), surface chroma multiplied 3-5x at unchanged lightness, so paper and rules read pale-blue without moving any contrast ratio.

Second accent: Upwork brand green #14A800, bound to the rule "green leaves the site for Upwork, azure acts here". Fill variant #0F8200 (4.98:1 with white) because the brand value itself is only 3.17:1 under a white label.
